_readme: Hand-authored for now, in the schema CAMT's Channel Manager (menu 40, ADR-0020) writes for cadenzaarthouse.com and modelauctions.net, so that it can adopt this file without a rewrite. Until it does, this is a placeholder and not a parallel authority: lineup membership, order and the editorial fields (title, location, year, description) are the Channel Manager's to own. The page's presentation fields (cast, chapters, tags, art) live in streaming.json, which the Channel Manager does not own.
